property_summary: Only the contract's current owner (msg.sender) may ever execute setOwner: any call originating from a non-owner caller must revert and leave owner unchanged; the tx.origin mutant lets an intermediary contract called by the owner succeed, changing owner.
change_summary: Replace the check `msg.sender == owner` with `tx.origin == owner` so calls from contracts initiated by the owner are allowed while direct calls from the owner made via some flows differ.
